relations: Swaying leaves intermittently occlude the sun, shifting its glare from a sharp starburst to a softer white bloom.
Movement of the foreground foliage causes lens-flare spots and bright sky patches to drift and reshape across the frame.
caption: The video captures an upward view through a dense tree canopy, where the sun glows brightly from the upper left, partly veiled by leaves. A thin dark branch cuts diagonally across the frame while a vertical trunk anchors the left edge and pale sky shows through gaps on the right. Green foliage with scattered yellowing leaves sways gently in the wind, shifting against the largely static framing. As the leaves move, the sun's glare changes character, growing from a sharp starburst into a broader, softer white bloom. Lens-flare spots and bright sky patches drift and reshape with the swaying foreground.
